articles.title: Houston Astros vs. Chicago White Sox: How teams match up in American League wild-card series
articles.description: The Astros and White Sox will meet for the third time in a playoff series. Here's how the position-by-position matchups break down for the wild-card round.

articles.title: Houston Astros to open with AJ Blubaugh in Game 1 against White Sox in wild-card series
articles.description: AJ Blubaugh led the majors with 96 innings of relief work this season and will be first man up in a 'bullpen' game to open wild-card series.

articles.title: Why NBC analyst Anthony Rizzo is bullish on the Houston Astros as MLB playoffs begin
articles.description: Anthony Rizzo, the former first baseman turned NBC analyst, says the Astros are built for short series like the one against the White Sox in the wild-card round.

articles.title: Astros weren't great in regular season, but neither were these teams that reached World Series
articles.description: The Astros are the first team with a .500 record to make the MLB postseason. They can look this list of teams who also underachieved in the regular season, but got hot at the right time.

articles.title: Houston Astros slugger Yordan Alvarez wins AL batting title to cap an MVP-worthy season
articles.description: Yordan Alvarez won the AL batting title with a .316 average. He finished second in home runs with 42 and RBIs with 106 in an MVP-caliber season.

articles.title: Astros rebound from 11 games under .500, win AL West despite finishing 81-81
articles.description: The Houston Astros have clinched the AL West title for the fifth time in six years. Despite a challenging season, they secured the division crown on the final day of the regular season. Manager ...

articles.title: Houston Astros' playoff hopes come down to game 162: What they need to happen
articles.description: The Rangers' win Saturday left the Astros needing to keep pace as the AL West race will come down to the final day of the regular season.

articles.title: Houston Astros recall Raynel Delgado as insurance for Isaac Paredes and send Ronel Blanco down
articles.description: Isaac Paredes fouled a ball off his knee on Saturday but was in the lineup for Sunday's finale. Raynel Delgado offers insurance.

articles.title: How Hayden Wesneski's 'incredible' effort saved Houston Astros' bullpen for season-defining finale
articles.description: With Houston desperate for an effective start, Hayden Wesneski gave more than that, providing length to preserve the Astros' relief corps for Sunday's AL West-deciding finale.

articles.title: Houston Astros miss a chance to extend lead in AL West with a sloppy loss to the Athletics
articles.description: A missed double play allowed the A's to score 6 runs in the 6th inning to take a 6-5 win and leave Astros tied in AL West with 2 games to go.
